Re: Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial  
Requested service: Hip arthroscopy  
CPT code: 29914  
Reference number: POC-37F3AA304D-16940  
Date of denial notice: July 31, 2026  

To Cigna Healthcare:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for hip arthroscopy, CPT 29914. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. The clinical records establish the diagnosis, severity, failed conservative treatment, functional impairment, and absence of relevant contraindications.

The requested procedure is supported by the following documentation:

- I have experienced 14 months of progressive hip pain that has not resolved with rest.
- I completed 16 weeks of supervised physical therapy focused on core and hip stabilization, together with activity modification. The treatment occurred from February 23, 2026, through June 15, 2026, and included 24 completed visits. These details are documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for four months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on March 21, 2026, produced only four weeks of partial relief.
- The June 24, 2026, MRI arthrogram demonstrates an anterosuperior labral tear and cam-type femoroacetabular impingement, with an alpha angle of 68 degrees. The joint space is preserved and the Tonnis grade is 0.
- I have sharp anterior groin pain with sitting and pivoting and cannot run or squat.
- Examination shows positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection or untreated substance use. I am a nonsmoker, and my BMI is 29.
- The procedure was requested by Okafor, MD, an orthopedic surgeon.

These records directly address the clinical information needed to evaluate hip arthroscopy for symptomatic cam-type femoroacetabular impingement with an associated labral tear. They document persistent symptoms, objective imaging findings, failed nonsurgical treatment, temporary or inadequate response to medication and injection, substantial functional limitations, and examination findings consistent with the diagnosis. They also document preserved joint space and the absence of the contraindicating conditions identified in the submitted clinical history.

Please reconsider and overturn the denial and approve prior authorization for CPT 29914. If Cigna believes any specific information remains missing, please identify each missing document or clinical fact in writing and explain how it is required under the criteria applied to this request. Please also provide the complete medical-necessity criteria and the exact version used to review this request.

I am not quoting plan language in this appeal because the complete policy text applied to this denial was not available to me. This appeal is based on the clinical records listed above and requests review under the criteria actually applied to reference number POC-37F3AA304D-16940.

Enclosed are the available supporting records:

1. MRI arthrogram report dated June 24, 2026  
2. Physical therapy discharge note documenting treatment from February 23, 2026, through June 15, 2026, and 24 completed visits  
3. Medication and injection treatment history  
4. Orthopedic examination and clinical evaluation by Okafor, MD  
5. The July 31, 2026, denial notice  

Please send the appeal determination and any additional appeal rights in writing.

Sincerely,

Taylor Kimura  
Member ID: W354999576
